notes.title: Update Celebration and Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hey friends,

To celebrate the recent Update 1.2., we decided to have a 30% discount this week!



In addition, I'd like to tell you a bit about the playability on Steam Deck, as the game has not received an official verification yet.

I had the Steam Deck in mind long before release, and with a simple 2D Platformer, it's no surprise that it runs great on the Steam Deck. This has been thoroughly tested internally, as well as indicated by players on Steam through reviews and forum posts.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/dde21af1e07cdf5bee5d1c1d423b7b984f715157.jpg"]Magical Delicacy running on the Steam Deck.



Input

Steam Deck's controller input is fully supported using Xbox input icons and allows for easy rebinding through the in-game settings. The on-screen keyboard is never needed.

Display

Automatic UI scaling ensures that all essential information remains legible and accessible, even if some non-essential information is slightly small or partially obscured. Steam Decks 16:10 resolution of 1280x800 is fully utilized without black bars.

System Support

No launcher or other additional input is needed to run the game. It runs perfectly using Proton. Additionally, the game is not overly battery-intensive.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/81b679489c3ab226e69afa81d6cba69f3edce261.jpg"]Captured on Steam Deck.



All the quality-of-life features introduced in past updates, such as the field guide, also make it simpler to play the game on the go without needing external resources or guides.



Read more about the recent update: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2231190/announcements/detail/514085449373846055"][/dynamiclink]

Delivery, ahoy!  

Steven

notes.title: Major Update 1.2. Now Available
notes.content:
Hey Friends,  

The second major update hits shelves today! This update focuses on new difficulty settings to tailor the game more closely to your desired level of comfort and includes other improvements.

Take a look at the new features awaiting you in Magical Delicacy:

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/33c7dfe30c8016100e3cd1ca553186006ba3710b.png

Difficulty Settings

The game now prompts you to select a difficulty upon starting a new game. Existing savegames will default to the normal difficulty but can be adjusted from the settings at any time. You'll be able to select from three presets and tailor those more to your liking in the game's settings. The difficulty modes include:

Relaxing - The relaxing preset offers a more easygoing experience. You'll start with additional items and keepsakes (Keepsakes are used in the game to unlock new features and abilities.) Easy Platforming will be enabled by default.

Normal - The normal preset offers a balanced experience. Based on the feedback on the game since its release.

Challenging - The challenging preset offers a strongly unguided experience. This aims to provide a more difficult experience, as envisioned in the original release, focused on limited resources and exploration that requires deep engagement with the map and mechanics to progress.

These presets determine your starting gear, enable or disable a few customizable difficulty settings, or even adjust the pricing and balancing of a few items you'll encounter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/d4c3a4a6e8cbe23fb6daf4c5c706cafbd6f891ff.png

In addition to these difficulty presets, there are other new options available in the settings, some of them already set to different default values depending on the preset:


 General Adjustments tweak a variety of parameters in the game to adjust the overall difficulty.
 Easy Platforming is moved from the accessibility section to the difficulty settings. Easy Platforming disabled most platforms with timed elements and various level hazards.
 Successful Wares Hint indicates for each of your created wares whether they can be delivered to an active order.
 Delivery Directions shows you the direction towards characters with actively pinned orders while in the same level with them to help you find that last stretch of the way.
 Faster Plant Growth decreases the time needed for plants to regrow within the town and in your garden.
 Disable Equipment Limit allows you to use all equippable keepsakes simultaneously.
 Increase Inventory Capacity allows you to double the inventory limit.
 Instant Cooking eliminates all cooking times and prevents burning.
 Rewards allow you to adjust the amount of beads you receive for delivering an order.

All these settings can be adjusted at any given time. Please be aware that the starting items given to you, depending on the preset selected at the start of the game, will remain unaffected when switching difficulty for that save game. Additionally, the difficulty menu is only accessible while being in-game and is set per save. Achievements can be earned with all difficulties.

Note: Many expressed concerns and frustrations with the gameplay have already been strongly improved with previous updates. This update aims to alleviate almost all remaining points of frustration. With inclusions such as enabling instant cooking times and receiving additional help with deliveries, you'll be able to tailor the experience to your desired level of comfort. The addition of the challenging preset aims to restore the exploration and trial-and-error aspect that some press and players praised when the game first came out while still maintaining access to newer comfort features.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/2674e2eac3ea8bb88292d7dc226ea0b433ca0dc6.png

Adjustable Tutorial

Together with the adjustable difficulty, the game now prompts you to adjust the amount of tutorial hints that are displayed by selecting different presets:


 Normal shows the full amount of tutorial hints.
 Reduced removes a lot of tutorial hints aimed at basic controls and easily understood mechanics for anyone who's familiar with similar games.
 Minimal shows as few tutorials as possible for anyone who wants to find out on their own - except for some very specific explanations in select cases.


[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/b7b6c6b8a67ab114e096af25b3953c977b37678a.png

Teleport Home

The new "Whistle of Crows" Keepsake allows you to return home to the storefront at almost any moment. [spoiler]You can get it by purchasing it from Tauno[/spoiler]. Once equipped, you can travel home by using the map. 

Note: While almost its own comfort feature on its own, the new Whistle Keepsake can reduce time waiting or spent running back and forth significantly so you can focus on the fun parts, though it needs to be acquired first.

[hr][/hr]

Other Improvements


 [spoiler]Silas will now be available as a merchant and sell Ancient Cap after giving some out for free.[/spoiler]
 The inventory can now hold up to 99 (previously 19) ingredients of a single type - inventory limit still applies.
 Significantly increased amount of compost that can be stacked in the compost.
 [spoiler]The Altar now shows the required item rarity once the first item is placed.[/spoiler]
 Cooking Modules will now show before purchase if they can be used to enhance ingredients.
 Improved the guide graphic for the "determining flavors" entry to more clearly display the specific intensities of flavors.
 You can now set the game to mute all audio while in the background/unfocused. You can find this setting in the audio settings. (Only on PC)


[hr][/hr]

I hope these new features can increase your comfort in the world of Magical Delicacy, but don't be afraid to face up to the challenge of playing without!

Delivery, ahoy!
Steven

notes.title: Major Update 1.1 Now Available
notes.content:
Hey Friends,

This is the first of a few planned updates that will improve the gameplay of Magical Delicacy and address some concerns and frustration. The idea of the game was always to be very unguided and explorative, and while that's loved by some, I realize that there are still some opportunities to  make the game even more cozy and relaxing.

Take a look at the new features awaiting you in Magical Delicacy:

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/727b9757dec8567d53a0ce6a35b3549a1ff97c08.png
New Field Guide
The new field guide page in Flora's Grimoire keeps track of all ingredients you have discovered, including all their variants once created and ways to acquire or purchase them.


 A Field Guide Keepsake has been added and can be purchased from [spoiler]Sana[/spoiler]. Once purchased, it will unlock the Field Guide page in the Grimoire (main inventory) and allow you to view all discovered ingredients.
 The Field Guide also tracks used and planted ingredients, which helps to get that last achievement.

Note: Some of you have been making lists and sheets of ingredients. As much as I admire that dedication and love seeing players willing to engage with a game so deeply, I realize that many of you are looking for a more comfortable experience. Therefore, this new field guide with lots of information is a first step for you to have quick access to crucial information.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/c04ee03623352b597f8983ef042954aef1822766.png
New Map Details
Colo has been very actively carving new map markers for Flora. This includes multiple intricate little pieces of the local plants and portraits of the townsfolk.


 Plant Markers have been added, automatically marking the locations of collectible plants on the map. The Plant Markers [spoiler]can be purchased from Colo and don't need to be equipped.[/spoiler] Unfortunately, the markers will only show up once you have newly interacted with the plants, even for existing savegames.
 Delivery Markers have been added, automatically marking the locations of active orders on the map. The Delivery Markers can be purchased [spoiler]from Colo and don't need to be equipped.[/spoiler]

Note: Hopefully, this new information on the map will alleviate some of your frustration with searching for the right things. As many players have also expressed their love for how unguided and exploration-heavy this game is, these new markers come as optional [spoiler]purchases from Colo.[/spoiler]

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/0b8fecb546b40b86b6bd7b2c7d4f14634ee8f9d0.png
Quickly Pass Time
A little magical pocket watch has been spotted in Grat.


 A Pocket Watch has been added, allowing you to rapidly pass time while sitting on benches. It can be acquired by [spoiler]collecting the new pickup in the Ryverfarer Station.[/spoiler]
 Additional benches have been added to levels.

Note: Despite the popular request to sleep during the day, having no limitations breaks the flow of time intended for the growth of plants. The new pocket watch takes a little more conscious effort but allows it to be used while already close to where you want to explore.

[hr][/hr]
Improved Tutorials
Added and improved some of the tutorials.


 New Tutorial Hints have been added in the early game to help with more easily overlooked elements.
 Improved Tutorial Hints have been added for the [spoiler]Broom and Altar[/spoiler].
 Revisit Previous Tutorial Hints by selecting "Tutorial" within the Guide in your main inventory. Some tutorial hints appear only after they naturally appear in the game to avoid spoilers.

[hr][/hr]
Unstuck
In rare cases where Flora gets stuck in places where she shouldn't be, it can prove helpful to have a way out.


 An Unstuck button was added to the pause menu to reset the player.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/37dc697c8098f2607a73fcdf32b964daed2d5f60.png
Harvesting Ingredients
Harvesting plants around town has become more involved.


 A Critical Zone has been added to the reaction minigame for harvesting ingredients in the town. Hitting the critical zone in the center of the target will now yield a better reward.

Note: While disabling this minigame in the settings is possible, players who disable it will benefit from a rare chance to gain two ingredients upon harvesting.

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/87a8246fdbbfb460863e722839bb2ffc5a6ad38b.png
Ingredient Handling

 Storage Units can now be accessed directly during cooking.
 Improved Ingredient Filters by possible and current enhancement (ground, roasted, etc.) an rarity (common, rare, etc.). Enhancements are limited to having discovered the corresponding kitchen tool.

[hr][/hr]
Other Improvements

 Info on purchasing keepsakes was updated to clarify whether they need to be equipped.
 The game will now automatically pause when opening the Steam Overlay.
 Storage UI will no longer open the move dialog if the destination is full.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed some Orders not showing up. If you're still missing an order from a character despite them seemingly giving one to you, try talking to them again.
 Fixed some bugs and freezes on certain dialogues when the game is set to a specific language.

While there are still things I’d like to add to the game, I hope that these changes help you all have the best experience possible!  I'll keep looking out for how these changes are received and might adjust accordingly. Thanks to everyone who cared enough to voice their thoughts on the game. And stay tuned – there’s more to come in the future!

What better time to enjoy this update than during the coming winter months. We'll start this with a 20% sale in the Steam Cooking Fest from November 11 - 18.

Delivery, ahoy!
Steven

notes.title: Minor Update #1
notes.content:
Hey there,

Thank you all for actively engaging in discussions around the game or even streaming your first steps in Grat! 

I’ve enjoyed hearing your thoughts on the game, seeing how many of you are enjoying this magical witchy world, and listening to your feedback. With that in mind, today, I’ve released the first small patch, which includes some balancing, first quality-of-life additions, and a few bug fixes.

You’ve explored the most secret corners of Grat and carefully collected many ingredients. For those of us who don’t want to be caught without the ingredients we need when we need them, it can be hard to part with them. Therefore, with increased storage capacities, you may feel free to hoard your ingredients like a dragon! However, there is still a limit, so you may want to sometimes take a step back before stocking your shelves and ask yourself, “does this ingredient spark joy?”  

I’m sure you’ve noticed that one of my main ideas for the game was to allow you to find your way through this twisted world and figure things out on your own. I understand that sometimes that can take away from what many of you want to do in the game — find out what happens next in the story! Because of this, I’ve made some changes to make that a little easier, especially in the early hours of the game.

I'm also already working on a lot of other stuff that should fill your hungry stomachs and help you explore Grat, so keep an eye out for those in the coming weeks.

Delivery, ahoy!
Steven

notes.title: Magical Delicacy OUT NOW
notes.content:
Dear Friends, 

The time has come for you to start exploring Grat! I hope you have a nice time in this little world I created, and I'm glad to finally share this game with you. To celebrate the launch, we're starting with a 10% discount! 

Dale North's amazing original soundtrack is now available on Steam and even included in a bundle with the game!

If that's not enough, head to https://whitethorngames.com/shop for some limited-edition merch!

I'm looking forward to all your thoughts and reactions!

Delivery, Ahoy!
Steven

Watch the new launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=wuTxvFzMM58;full][/previewyoutube]

In Magical Delicacy, you play as Flora, who arrives in the harbor town of Grat in hopes of making her dreams of becoming a fully-fledged witch come true. Upon arrival, she is given a place to live in exchange for delivering magical foods and potions to a variety of townsfolk. Through the love of cooking, she'll discover their stories and the mythical secrets that make Grat a truly magical place to live.

To create these magical dishes and potions, Flora will need to collect an assortment of fresh ingredients from shops around Grat, throughout the town, and her own garden. With the ability to upgrade her kitchen, there isn't a dish in her spellbook that couldn't satisfy her hungry customers.

notes.title: Magical Delicacy is part of Metroidvania Fusion
notes.content:
Dear friends,

From March 04. - 11. you can find Magical Delicacy amongst many other great Metroidvania games in the Metroidvania Fusion event: 

Metroidvania Fusion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/acd22a9e776bcf1949b1aac59ac477f69cad3d72.png

Check out the event for great sales, demos, and an overview of upcoming games!

Now, let's be real for a minute. Is Magical Delicacy a Metroidvania? Surely it can't be without any fighting or big boss encounters? An essential part for me in a Metroidvania is the way you explore and access new parts of the map, so I set out to combine this part of the genre with the gameplay of cooking and cozy games. Despite the lack of fighting, I'm sure you'll see many similarities in how you progress through its world when it comes out later this year. 

You'll visit a densely packed town with people to meet and make delicious food for. Find new merchants to unlock new ways to cook or harvest ingredients throughout the nooks and crannies of the town. Meet mysterious travelers, adventurers, and forgotten legends. Unravel the island's secrets, climb bell towers and old ramparts, or delve through lost caves. Grow as a witch and acquire upgrades to your movement abilities to discover new routes and hard-to-reach places or open shortcuts that lead back to your store, where the cooking magic happens.

The demo is only a tiny glimpse into the platforming and exploration and focuses more on cooking and introducing the story, but try it yourself!

notes.title: Flora's Magical Delicacies
notes.content:
Today, we wanted to get to the heart of the action, so we sent one of our team to pay Flora a visit and see just how talented the young witch is. Here’s what they had to say:

“I recently had the opportunity to visit the beautiful harbor town of Grat. While I was there, I ordered food from a lovely new resident named Flora. I must say, the experience I had with Flora’s dishes was a magical one and quite unforgettable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/b24ece4bf4b8ac589abad5e5d7c40c610aaa82af.png
“I soon realized Flora was able to prepare a variety of dishes — pretty much anything a customer could ask for! I asked her how she came to have such a large selection. Flora told me how she received recipes for some of her dishes, while others are of her own creation. When I heard this, I was curious and ordered something she created, and let me tell you, it did not disappoint!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/e075409309484799c3970c551db588a1e3c2f6b4.png
“One of her best qualities is that she can suit any taste with her substitutions. For example, one dish I ordered was quite spicy, but it was no problem for Flora — she added a few ingredients, and it helped counteract the heat that affected my palate! It was wonderful and such a kind thing for her to do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/606592018a8bd5ace4e2080ed35d5e24996b39c2.png
“Each of her dishes only uses the highest quality of fresh ingredients that she often gets from local suppliers, forges on her own, or freshly grown in her very own garden in the back of her shop. Just know that if you order from Flora, you are getting the best!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/7514b6e2f8059f8ad808c73b4717b33a94197186.png
"Lastly, her delivery is top-notch! With Flora, there is no need to pick up your food from her storefront; she will bring the food right to you! When my meal arrived, it was as warm and fresh as if it just came out of the oven! So, if you’re in Grat, whether a local or a tourist, I highly recommend ordering from Flora directly if she happens to pass you by while making her delivery rounds. You know I will!”

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for staying for this look into the cooking and delivery in the world of Magical Delicacy!

notes.title: The Witches of Magical Delicacy
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

For this spooky season, I want to give you a little insight into the mystical residents you'll discover in Magical Delicacy! Playing as Flora, you'll encounter a host of interesting characters that populate the seaside town of Grat, including the witches who will help (or hinder) you on your journey. Let's have a look at the two witch covens you'll encounter in Flora's new home:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/7da6a998672c4cf6a41c24e33e9e881a73d337d4.png

Visiting Grat, you will stumble upon two witch covens operating as the guardians of magic: the Shena Circle and the Keskar Dawn. Their goals align, but their beliefs and ways of handling situations could not be more different, resulting in an ongoing rivalry between the two groups.

The Shena Circle is a coven of witches who believe the river that runs through the island where Grat is located is the sole sacred source of the Mist, which allows them to wield water-based magic. These witches believe everything coming from the Mist must be accepted as a nourishing gift to the greater good of the town.

On the other hand, The Keskar Dawn is a group of vigilante magi who seek to protect magical beings and oppose the increased research by adventurers and academics alike in their safe haven, the river’s wellspring. The Keskar Dawn wields umbral magic and believes leaving the river wellspring untouched will be the best for Grat.

As Flora becomes more familiar with Grat, she will meet the Shenai witch, Cassia, and the Keskar magus, Tauno, who both have much to teach her. Will their rivalry get in the way of Flora’s goals? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/a753ff0514677528e326b708077e267732ac68bf.png

Thank you for staying for this look into the world of Magical Delicacy!

Steven

notes.title: Cooking Trailer - Wholesome Direct
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

It has been only a few months since I announced the game, and while I've been busy working on one task after the other on the game, I got the fantastic opportunity to have a spot on this year's Wholesome Direct! If you don't know, Wholesome Direct is an annual Showcase organized by Wholesome Games on YouTube and Twitch, showcasing wholesome and cozy games. I'm very grateful for this opportunity and would love to welcome everyone coming here from this showcase to my little world of magic in Magical Delicacy.

Cooking Trailer

Watch the new Cooking Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=lVHSPk92QZE;full][/previewyoutube]
Or watch the full Wholesome Direct on YouTube. 

Cooking in Magical Delicacy utilizes a deep attribute-based ingredient system, where each ingredient has unique properties which will affect the outcome of your meals, potions, and more. You'll learn how these properties influence each other throughout the game. The orders from your friends and customers for your freshly cooked food will always come with specific requirements that you must fulfill, which are met by choosing the right ingredients based on their properties. With this cooking system, you'll have the freedom to be creative while having puzzling challenges when creating your customer-pleasing dishes.

Key Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667059/319af421b8473b163e43f4ac324ecdaa5d31220b.png

I finally put more time into drawing and came up with a new key illustration for the game that better reflects the atmosphere I'm going for. The artworks got refreshed across the board to reflect Magical Delicacy in a new light.

[hr][/hr]

Until next time! Thanks to everyone expressing interest in my first game; it means a lot! Make sure to share the game and wishlist it to support it!

notes.title: Official Game Announcement - Whitethorn Winter
notes.content:
Dear Reader,

After a few years of quiet development, I'm excited to tell you about my first game, Magical Delicacy. Last weekend I revealed it with my publisher, Whitethorn Games, at the Whitethorn Winter Showcase.

Watch the official announcement trailer:

Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=2nQhEmG8nDE;full][/previewyoutube]

With Magical Delicacy, I am creating an odd mix of a wholesome and accessible cooking game and a Metroidvania-inspired platformer. The main goal lies in cooking delicious meals and delivering them to friends and customers. In your own kitchen in the center of the city, you will be able to cook various types of foods; then, on your deliveries, you will have to explore the town, find and befriend characters, and stock up on ingredients through different means. You can read a more detailed description on the store page if you want to learn more.

[hr][/hr]

Accessibility
[previewyoutube=Zg6ulgvGz40;full][/previewyoutube]
Whitethorn Games' Usability & Accessibility Specialist Britt Dye prepared a small segment about accessibility for the Whitethorn Winter Showcase, including a small preview of features that will be available in Magical Delicacy.

[hr][/hr]

As a solo developer, having Whitethorn Games to back me up for publishing and marketing is a big relief. I have Dale North from Scarlet Moon Productions on board for the soundtrack, whose work you can already hear in the announcement trailer; it's a perfect fit for the game! Still, a lot of work is in my own hands, and I'm doing my best to craft a lovely experience for you. The road ahead is still long, so until the game gets into your hands, the best you can do now is to wishlist the game!

Meanwhile, I look forward to telling you much more about Flora and the world you will visit with her.

Delivery ahoy!
Steven
